info.name: Plex Media Server Metadata Agents API
Get the list of available metadata agent providers

params.name: metadataTypes
params.description: A comma-separated list of metadata types to filter the providers by. If not specified, all providers are returned.

items.docs: Get the list of all available metadata agent providers for this PMS.

params.name: uri
params.description: The URI of the metadata agent provider to add.

items.docs: This endpoint registers a metadata agent provider with the server. The provider URI must respond with a valid MediaProvider response.

params.name: providerId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider to get

items.docs: Get the metadata agent provider with the given id.

params.name: providerId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider to modify

params.name: uri
params.description: The new URI of the metadata agent provider.

items.docs: Modify the metadata agent provider with the given id. Only the URI is passed, the response to the URI will determine the other properties.

params.name: providerId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider to delete

items.docs: Deletes a metadata agent provider with the given id. This will fail if the provider is being used inside a MetadataAgentGroup.

info.name: Get the list of available metadata agent provider groups

items.docs: Get the list of all available metadata agent provider groups for this PMS.

info.name: Add a metadata agent provider group

params.name: title
params.description: The title of the metadata agent provider group to add.

params.name: primaryIdentifier
params.description: The identifier of the metadata agent provider which will be the primary for the group.

items.docs: This endpoint registers a new metadata agent provider group and creates a new MetadataAgentGroupItem for the primraryIdentifier.

info.name: Get a metadata agent provider group

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider group to get

items.docs: Get the metadata agent provider group with the given id.

info.name: Modify a metadata agent provider group

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider group to update

params.name: title
params.description: The title of the metadata agent provider group to update.

items.docs: Modify the metadata agent group with the given id. Only the title can be changed.

info.name: Delete a metadata agent provider group

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider group to delete

items.docs: Deletes a metadata agent provider group with the given id. This will also delete any MetadataAgentGroupItem objects associated with the group.

info.name: Modify a metadata agent provider group's items

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent group

params.name: providerId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider

params.name: after
params.description: The ID of the group item to place this item after. This only works if the group item already exists. A -1 value will place the item at the beginning.

items.docs:
Modify a metadata agent provider group's items. This will assign the specified provider id to the group if it does not already exist.

Providing the optional after query parameter on an existing group item will move its position in the group relative to the item with the specified ID.

info.name: Delete a metadata agent provider group item

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider group

params.name: providerId
params.description: The ID of the metadata agent provider

items.docs: Deletes a metadata agent provider group item with the given id.
